current_findings: The production product entry currently reaches the admitted native Product Authority for a non-adopted Goal fixture, but does not execute the R2-02 controlled task.

cognitionVertical.test.ts exercises ContextManifest, Decision and Action on one controlled store. The dispatcher result is an accepted command receipt; the tested vertical explicitly has no Outcome writer or reader.

PiManagedSession observes JSONL events and distinguishes a prompt ACK from completion. The pinned Pi RPC protocol supplies agent_settled after retry and queued continuation, while agent_end alone can be followed by more work. A settled event still needs result and process-custody validation before Outcome.

Native process custody exists in native-host process/windows.rs, but the current NativeHostClient and store session protocol do not expose a product task process operation. R2-02 must connect a bounded typed operation to the existing custody rather than spawn an unmanaged second authority.

Existing native appendObjectiveOutcome, appendEvaluation and appendDreamProposal methods target local authority records. They cannot be used as proof of Git/GitHub adoption under the current ledger decision.

The plan requires an Owner-selected test project repository and authorized work branch for real Git/GitHub writes. No exact repository and branch scope was found in the v2 plan or current checkpoints; the Owner was asked for these coordinates. This blocks only remote-write execution, not in-contract implementation and local controlled tests.
